I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is on **25 November**.

Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. Marcus is a member of #north-team, so he can see her message himself. A renewal date counts as an account fact, not a money term, so it's fine to share with the team.
